text:
emma_prod: Quick flag from user testing: in-app help shows 'Snippets' while docs and nav say 'Guides'. Folks get tripped up. Also some deep links land at top.

john_design: Thanks. I think our snippet generator is pulling raw copy. We should standardize on one label. 'Guides' OK?

emma_prod: Yes, prefer 'Guides' to match nav.

kevin_docs: I'll run a grep to find all occurrences. Short-term we can add a small client-side map to rewrite 'Snippets' -> 'Guides' when rendering. Longer-term add canonical_slug in frontmatter.

sora_eng: For deep links: some headings changed, breaking anchors. We can add a redirects.json mapping legacy hashes to new slugs and have the console rewrite links. Low-risk.

a11y-bot: a11y: if opening the doc in a modal, ensure focus lands on the main heading and set aria-modal. Also check contrast on snippet body in dark theme.

john_design: Proposal: change help panel to title + 1-line blurb + explicit "Open full Guides" (new tab). That avoids modal focus problems and reduces stale copy shown.

emma_prod: Owners?

kevin_docs: I'll own the canonical term sweep and add redirects.json to the next docs build.

sora_eng: I'll wire client rewrite + emit docs_redirect telemetry when a legacy hash is remapped. Also add focus fix for modal in case we keep it.

john_design: I'll update the panel copy and color tokens for contrast.

emma_prod: Timeline: aim for PRs by Wednesday, canary Thursday. Please @me on PRs. Thanks!
